item.title: Bulletin updated at 09:50 HKT 25/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon has reached the coast of Guangdong today. The weather will become cold appreciably and rather windy over the region on Sunday and Monday. An upper-air disturbance will also bring cloudy weather and some rain to the region. With the monsoon moderating gradually and the upper-air disturbance departing, the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week, but it will remain cool in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 25/12 (Saturday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground later.
Weather: Sunny periods. Becoming cool with one or two light rain patches at night.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
